verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs is an agent evaluation and simulation platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence never documents a first-party Chronicle MCP server that agents can connect to. The only MCP mention is that a custom environment version can describe MCP servers inside the simulated world under test. That is a building block for building test environments, not an official MCP server for the product, so it earns no credit.
